tutorialModalBody:
This application is based on DocuTranslate and adds support for engineering files DXF/DWG.

  1. Step 1: Choose a workflow

    You can keep automatic workflow selection enabled or choose a workflow manually.

    • DXF Drawing Translation: Translates .dxf engineering drawings. It supports TEXT, MTEXT, ATTRIB, block text, table text, and leader text; it cleans, filters, deduplicates text, and exports the translated DXF plus terminology CSV files.
    • DWG Drawing Translation: Translates .dwg engineering drawings. The app calls ODA File Converter to convert DWG to DXF, reuses the DXF workflow, then converts the translated result back to the selected DWG version. Install ODA File Converter first or select its executable path in DWG options.
    • Markdown Conversion then Translation: For PDF, Markdown, images, and similar files.
    • TXT/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/EPUB/SRT/ASS/JSON/HTML: Choose the workflow matching the file type.
  2. Step 2: Configure parameters

    Set the AI provider, API URL, API key, model, target language, concurrency, retry, glossary, and custom prompt. DXF/DWG workflows also include text cleaning, text filtering, AI text filtering, ODA path, and DWG output version options.

  3. Step 3: Upload files

    Click or drag files into the task area to create translation tasks.

  4. Step 4: Start translation

    Click Start Translation on the task card and watch progress in the log area.

  5. Step 5: Download results

    Download the translated files when processing is complete. DXF/DWG tasks also provide terminology CSV files for later manual review.

DWG translation requires ODA File Converter. If the path is not detected, select it manually in the DWG options.
